source.instructions: Use a separate checkout at the baseline plus the complete patch and added files. The snapshot includes earlier active work; do not stack it on earlier patches.

changes: Moved convenience model acquisition, cache and device coordination into src/client/model-host; the previous runtime index and model-session paths remain one-line compatibility facades.
Extracted model evidence construction into model-evidence.js, reducing the model handle from 834 to 592 lines without changing public methods or evidence behavior.
Enforced transitive import exclusions: Pack core cannot import model-host or its legacy facades; host evidence cannot import GPU, loading, inference, Forge, or command machinery.
Made converter-owned Forge and tooling-owned command/file orchestration explicit in charters and architecture documentation. Historical evidence paths remain unchanged.
Added frozen candidate-evaluation contracts, balanced attempt order, complete source-oracle checks, retained failure observations, cancellation, and per-case observed-range Pareto selection.

Semantic search retains every valid candidate and distinguishes unmeasured proposal order from evaluation. Supplied evaluation must bind exactly the generated candidates and ModelIR; all-rejected evaluation prevents signing.
Connected evaluation to the existing Forge pipeline and CLI via --candidate-evaluation. Qualification and application acceptance remain separate gates.
Updated canonical charter inventory assertions, current evidence pointers, generated package closure, and measured package budgets; no public entry point was removed.
